match_id: DE ZERBI: “THE REFEREE WAS NOT CALM!”  Tottenham_Leeds_2026-05-11_SQATne1YvlE
team: DE ZERBI: “THE REFEREE WAS NOT CALM!”  Tottenham
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Hi there, Roberto. I mean, what do you say to  Mathys Tel? He’s obviously scored a wonderful  
goal and then he’s had that moment in his  own box as well. A big hug and a big kiss,  
nothing more, because he’s a young player,  he’s a big talent, he scored a great goal  
and he made a mistake for the experience,  because he has not the right experience.  
He has not played too many games in his career and  we have to accept. But I’m proud, I’m happy for  
the mentality we showed. We didn’t play a great  game like in Villa Park. We played a good game,  
I think enough to win. We could lose the game at  the end, because before the last 15, 20 minutes,  
they didn’t shoot on our goal, just one in  the first half. We had 14 corners against two,  
five chances to score against two. We came inside  the goal area 50 times against 27, but we didn’t  
score two goals. Could see you getting frustrated  on the sideline. You got a yellow card as well.  
What was upsetting you? Was it the officials? What  was it? No. Yes, but from the first minute until  
the end of the game, the referee went to me to  say, if you go out, yellow card. I think they were  
not calm today. Maybe they suffered the pressure  of yesterday’s West Ham, Arsenal game, the VAR,  
for sure. We suffer the pressure today because  of the speed of the ball, the order on the pitch.  
We didn’t play with patience, with the ball.  Frenetic in it. We were rushing. But also the  
referee was not calm today. I don’t know. I can’t  understand the polemic about yesterday in VAR,  
because it was a foul, 200%. No, 100%, 200%, if  you want to speak about football. Just the last  
one for me. James Maddison made his comeback. What  did you make of him? And did you expect him to get  
that long with all the added time as well? Great  news for us. He’s a different player as a quality,  
as a guy, and he will be, I hope, crucial for  us. Yesterday I spoke with him about his physical  
condition, about how many minutes he could play.  He played more than what he said yesterday.  
We are happy for him, but I think we are  in the right way. It will be tough until  
the last minute against Everton, for sure. But  after Sunderland game was difficult. Imagine  
ourselves before the last two games to stay up two  points on West Ham, because I remember very well  
the game in Sunderland was my first game,  and we can’t forget what was the situation  
just 15 days ago. We can’t forget after four  games in a row we made eight points. We can’t  
forget Leeds. The last defeat in the Premier  League of Leeds was the first of March at home,  
I think. Yeah, and West Ham, they have to play  also with Leeds at home. And I think Leeds, they  
will play like today, with the same spirit, with  the same qualities, because they are doing a great  
season. Have you had the chance to look back at  the potential penalty decision at the end? What  
did you think of it? No, no, no. I don’t want to  come inside the polemic. I didn’t see. I didn’t  
watch again. I don’t know. Ask me questions about  football if you want. I don’t know. And what about  
Antonin Kinsky again? Another great performance,  two spectacular saves. Yes, he’s improving a lot.  
He’s a good goalkeeper, but I had no doubt in my  first days in Tottenham because I knew him before  
to come here. When I came, he played in Madrid and  he made that mistake and was tough for him. But he  
has a great personality, strong character,  and he deserves to play a game like today.  
And kind of thinking about the attacking depth  more generally, obviously you brought Maddison  
on today. Is it such a high-energy style that you  play, players naturally tire towards the second  
half of the game. Is that depth difficult for you  to manage as a coach because there aren’t so many  
strikers or wide players for you to call upon  from the bench? Yes, but I think I am very lucky  
to have these players, even if we have too many  injuries. I think we have the quality enough. We  
have the players good enough to stay up. I said  like this after Sunderland, after Brighton. I  
think in the last four games we made eight points,  but we deserve more than eight points. But more  
than eight points. And for that I’m positive, I’m  happy, and I’m looking forward to start to work in  
this week and to prepare the next game. Roberto,  of those eight points, only two at home, and the  
team still haven’t won in the Premier League since  December 6th. Have you seen a mental problem or  
a difficulty with the team playing at home since  you’ve been? No, because Brighton. Did you watch  
the game with Brighton? Yes, yes. I think with  Brighton we played a great game. I think you did,  
but the same thing, you were leading and you  threw it away in a silly circumstance, which  
the team keep doing at home. Yes, but if you want  to speak about the performance, we speak about the  
performance. If we speak about the result, change  against Brighton. We played a fantastic game.  
Maybe, no, for sure, better than today and better  than Wolverhampton. Maybe worse than, or not so  
good like Aston Villa. But we deserved to win. And  today, yes, you are right, we didn’t play well. We  
didn’t play a great game. We played a good game.  I think we felt too much pressure. Can happen.  
Can happen. If you fight for the relegation, it is  different. What do you think is tougher, playing  
the final of the Europa League as a pressure or  the game like today, to fight for the relegation?  
It is tougher in terms of pressure. Probably  today, for sure, because they are two different  
pressures. But that’s not really my point. My  point is that the home form for Tottenham going  
back through lots of managers, it’s not your  fault. No, no. Now Tottenham is mine. I am the  
coach of Tottenham. The responsibility is mine.  And I have not to say other coaches. No, yes,  
for sure. We didn’t win the last two games, but  as a coach, I have to consider the performances,  
not just the result, because today, if we win  today, nothing changes in terms of performance,  
because anyway, we didn’t play a great game. But  we have to be honest and to say we didn’t play a  
great game, even if we win. And today we didn’t  win, we didn’t play a great game and we have to  
be honest. Everyone, everyone be honest, not just  me. We have to be honest also when we consider the  
VAR of West Ham, Arsenal. Foul 200% in football.  Okay, thank you very much. Thank you. Thank you.
